ps_rule: Cursor user rules live in your Cursor account
ps_skill: skill "../escape": the name is not a single folder name
ps_skillname: Cursor requires skill names of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
ps_nodesc: Cursor requires a skill description
ps_cred: skill file scripts/token.json matches the credential exclusion list
ps_cmd: the command has no prompt
ps_cmdname: the name has no characters usable in a file name
ps_cmdtext: the item is not valid UTF-8
ps_subname: the name has no characters usable in a file name
ps_allow: Cursor cannot restrict MCP servers to an allow list
ps_native: Cursor native permission entries are not supported
ps_foreign: nothing in this permission applies to Cursor
ps_hook: no cursor native entry
ps_nomcp: the item has no server definition
ps_ws: transport "ws" is not supported by Cursor
ps_both: a remote server needs a url and no command, args or env
ps_bare: a stdio server needs a command and no url or headers
